summary: Iteration 8 validated Draft/Publish for all 6 content types, Forgot Password flow (Resend placeholder → debug_reset_url), Reset token validation, single-use token + JWT invalidation, and Admin Dashboard auto-save + status toggle UI. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passing. Frontend: forgot/reset flow, invalid-token page, StatusPill toggle, publish/unpublish, and auto-save (Saving… → Saved) all verified. DB restored: admin password back to Admin@123, no TEST_ items remain in any collection.
critical_code_review_comments: useAutoSave: PUT sends full form incl. read-only fields (id, created_at, order). Backend currently tolerates this (returns 200) but consider stripping to writable subset before PUT to reduce network payload and prevent accidental override of server-managed fields.

SkillsTab.edit(): spreads the entire skill row into `form` (which then triggers first-render skip in useAutoSave). If user immediately edits, autosave fires with all extra keys. Fine today but brittle if schema tightens.
Public GET filtering relies on `is_admin_request` decoding JWT even for public GETs. Ensure this helper never raises on bad/expired tokens (verified in tests, but keep the try/except guard).
test_credentials: admin@abhinandan.dev / Admin@123 (restored at end of run)
seed_data_creation: None persisted. During testing: 1 draft skill 'TEST_Draft_Skill_UI' was created via UI and deleted via API; 1 'TEST_LEAK_CHECK' skill was created via curl and deleted. All parametrised backend tests create+delete their own items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Draft-visibility check from a second tab within the SAME Playwright browser context WILL show draft items because localStorage/JWT is shared and the shared axios client attaches Authorization. To verify true public visibility, either use a fresh incognito context, clear localStorage before goto('/'), or use raw HTTP (curl / requests without Authorization). The backend filter is correct — verified via curl. 2) Activity Log entries for Password Reset show 'email skipped (email_not_configured)' plus the full reset URL when RESEND_API_KEY starts with 're_xxxx' — this is expected. 3) On the very first admin session after login, if you try to edit-then-autosave a row that was JUST deleted, you'll see 'Auto-save failed' — a benign race, not a bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two initial false-positives explained: (a) 'draft leaked to public' UI test — root cause: shared localStorage/JWT across new Playwright pages in the same browser context; verified via curl that unauth public GET correctly excludes drafts. (b) 'skill-autosave: Auto-save failed' on first attempt — occurred because the previously-edited skill row had just been deleted in the same run, so the PUT hit a stale id; reran in isolation and observed clean Saving… → Saved transitions with HTTP 200.
